records.issue_text: app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — Applying a default limit of 50 truncates the public membership page, which has no pagination controls, making members beyond the first 50 inaccessible through that page.
records.rationale: The finding is accurate. The diff shows: 1) In group.js, `limit: 50` is set as default. 2) In group-members.js.es6 route, `model.findMembers()` is called once in setupController with no pagination actions. 3) In group/members.hbs template, it iterates over `members` but has no pagination controls (unlike the admin template which has next/previous actions). Previously, the members endpoint returned all members for non-automatic groups (the old controller had `if group.automatic?` check before applying limit/offset).
